# lora-kernel

> Experts defined by their corpora: one small LoRA per job on Gemma 4 E4B, trained on how to navigate an editable markdown knowledge base (search, open, follow links, calculate) rather than on its facts; a very small router that abstains to a frontier model outside every expert's corpus; served as an OpenAI-compatible API with OpenClaw on top. Apache-2.0. Every claim is marked [ran] (observed, run directory named), [read] (from source or a paper) or [spec] (decided, not built). Measurements are on generated suites, synthetic organisations and real regulations ingested verbatim; no real user traffic yet.

Key results, all [ran]: an inbox-triage expert 0.989 vs the bare base's 0.345; multi-hop questions over an unseen wiki of atomic statements, 38/40 on Gemma 4 E4B (bare 19/40); the same fluids adapter 11/90 through `tool_calls` and 90/90 served with results inline as its corpus taught — serve an expert the way it was trained before concluding a capability is absent. Not solved: multi-hop citation on real documents (13/21; four treatments tied their baseline); the router that passes (ROUTE0, a factored rule: 0 of 600 foreign texts served locally) is literal — paraphrases leave for the frontier, and no learned router passed; small models still invent, caught by a grounding check outside the model; no member yet scored on an external benchmark (τ²-bench installed, T0).

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/EvolvingAgentsLabs/lora-kernel/blob/main/README.md): the shape, the five pieces of 1.0, and a dated status: what works, what does not, what is not implemented
- [Memory specification](https://github.com/EvolvingAgentsLabs/lora-kernel/blob/main/docs/MEMORY.md): library, radar, three verbs (`<search>`, `<open>`, `<calc>`), the navigating LoRA, the runtime referee
- [Record](https://github.com/EvolvingAgentsLabs/lora-kernel/blob/main/docs/RECORD.md): everything measured, including negative results and instruments that lied, each line naming its run
- [Plan](https://github.com/EvolvingAgentsLabs/lora-kernel/blob/main/docs/PLAN.md): living milestones, each with gate and falsification condition written before it ran

## Weights

- [distributor-wiki@v2 on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/Matias/lora-kernel-distributor-wiki-gemma4-e4b): the trajectory LoRA on gemma-4-E4B-it, research preview, with its limits
- [Colab notebook](https://colab.research.google.com/github/EvolvingAgentsLabs/lora-kernel/blob/main/examples/colab/wiki_walk.ipynb): bare vs adapter on multi-hop questions, then edit one note and ask again

## Architecture and serving

- [Architecture](https://github.com/EvolvingAgentsLabs/lora-kernel/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): experts, router, memory, runtime, the small/large pair, the frontier
- [Serving](https://github.com/EvolvingAgentsLabs/lora-kernel/blob/main/docs/SERVING.md): vLLM multi-LoRA behind the OpenAI-compatible proxy (`training/harness/openai_proxy.py`)
- [OpenClaw](https://github.com/EvolvingAgentsLabs/lora-kernel/blob/main/docs/OPENCLAW.md): agents per task on top, as run live
- [Demo](https://github.com/EvolvingAgentsLabs/lora-kernel/blob/main/docs/DEMO.md): a reference organisation (school, distributor) with signed identity, held payments, grounding
- [Examples](https://github.com/EvolvingAgentsLabs/lora-kernel/tree/main/examples): code-only reference organisations and MCP servers

## Why and how it is measured

- [Knowledge trajectories](https://github.com/EvolvingAgentsLabs/lora-kernel/blob/main/docs/KNOWLEDGE-TRAJECTORIES.md): why weights should hold navigation and notes hold content; self-contained, written for review by other models
- [Framework gaps](https://github.com/EvolvingAgentsLabs/lora-kernel/blob/main/docs/FRAMEWORK.md): what works, what does not, what a generic framework would still need
- [Foundations](https://github.com/EvolvingAgentsLabs/lora-kernel/blob/main/docs/FOUNDATIONS.md): the mathematics, each section tied to the run that instantiates it
- [Instructions for coding agents](https://github.com/EvolvingAgentsLabs/lora-kernel/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): the measurement rules this project paid for
